summary: Comprehensive testing of download-requests endpoint, SEO metadata, template request forms, and admin panel filters completed successfully. All 23 backend tests passed (100% success rate). Frontend navigation, form validation, and admin panel functionality verified.
passed_tests: Backend: Root endpoint returns 200
Backend: Download request with valid data and marketing opt-in creates lead with correct structure
Backend: Download request without marketing opt-in defaults to false
Backend: Download request with consent=false returns 422
Backend: Download request with invalid email returns 422
Backend: Download request with invalid document_request enum returns 422
Backend: Download request with invalid language enum returns 422
Backend: Download request with unknown fields (extra='forbid') returns 422
Backend: Download request honeypot (website field filled) returns 201 but does NOT store
Backend: Download request with source_path containing query/hash returns 422
Backend: Admin filter by lead_type=download_request returns only download requests
Backend: Admin filter by lead_type=contact returns only contact leads
Backend: Admin filter by document_request=visit returns only visit requests
Backend: Admin filter by marketing_opt_in=true returns only opted-in leads
Backend: Admin filter by marketing_opt_in=false returns non-opted-in leads
Backend: Combined filters (download_request + visit + marketing=true) work correctly
Backend: Stored lead has correct fields: lead_type=download_request, source=template_request, consent_version=template-request-v1
Backend: Stored lead has consent fields: consented_at, consent_text, marketing_consent_text, source_path
Backend: CSV export includes consent fields (consent_version, consented_at, marketing_opt_in)
Frontend: Home page loads with template request section
Frontend: Document page (visit) loads with hero CTA anchor link to #download-acta
Frontend: Template request form has all required fields (email, processing consent, marketing consent, submit)
Frontend: Form validation shows error when consent is not checked
Frontend: Form submission succeeds when consent is checked, shows success message with marketing result
Frontend: Guide navigation sidebar has all anchor links (definition, checklist, preparation, mistakes, example, faq)
Frontend: FAQ section displays 5 FAQ items
Frontend: Related documents section displays 4 related document links
Frontend: Language switch from ES to EN works correctly, updates URL to /en/documents/site-visit-minutes
Frontend: Processing consent checkbox defaults to unchecked (false)
Frontend: Marketing consent checkbox defaults to unchecked (false)
SEO: Document page has correct title tag with route-specific content
SEO: Document page has meta description
SEO: Document page has canonical link
SEO: Document page has hreflang links (es, en, x-default)
SEO: Document page has JSON-LD structured data (Organization, WebPage, BreadcrumbList, Article, FAQPage)
SEO: Document page has H1 tag in body
Admin: Login page loads with token input
Admin: Login with correct admin token succeeds
Admin: Dashboard loads with KPIs and leads table
Admin: Lead type filter works (download_request, contact)
Admin: Document filter works (visit, setting, photos, snagging, completion)
Admin: Marketing filter works (true, false, all)
Admin: Search functionality works
Admin: Export CSV button is enabled when leads exist
Admin: Combined filters work correctly (download_request + visit + marketing=true)

additional_notes.seo_verification: Verified raw HTML via curl for /es/documentos/acta-visita-obra route. All SEO metadata is correctly rendered in initial server HTML (not client-side only). Title, description, canonical, hreflang, and JSON-LD structured data all present.
additional_notes.consent_defaults: Both processing consent and marketing consent checkboxes default to unchecked (false) as required. Marketing opt-in is optional and defaults to false when omitted from request.
additional_notes.honeypot: Honeypot field (website) works correctly - returns 201 but does NOT persist to database when filled.
additional_notes.rate_limiting: Rate limiting endpoint exists but was not explicitly tested in iteration 5. Iteration 6 includes dedicated rate limiting tests.
additional_notes.admin_filters: All three admin filters (lead_type, document_request, marketing_opt_in) work correctly individually and in combination.
additional_notes.csv_export: CSV export includes all required consent fields: consent_version, consented_at, consent_text, marketing_consent_text, document_request, marketing_opt_in.
additional_notes.form_validation: Form validation correctly blocks submission when: email is invalid, consent is false, or document_request is invalid.
additional_notes.success_messaging: Success message clearly states: 'There is no file to download yet. No document has been emailed and no account has been created.' - honest messaging as required.
additional_notes.language_switch: Language switch preserves page context - switching from /es/documentos/acta-visita-obra to /en/documents/site-visit-minutes works correctly.
